text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
The ticket for the frozen gatehouse tablet at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging is **#88412**. I posted that as a reply to Hollis's message in #central-random.

It comes from Tobias Rendle's message in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025. That's a channel Hollis is in, so I only told them what they could already see. The ticket was a Tier 2 escalation: the tablet froze while scanning the barcode on the bill of lading (BOL). In the same thread, Tobias first called the customer "TP", which got it confused with Tansley Parcel. He then confirmed #88412 belongs to Tansleigh Packaging.

The shared file area has no ticket files at all, so I couldn't check the number against a ticket record or see whether the ticket is still open.

text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply? Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
